witness.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d); cp private/witness/core.cpp "$tmp/core.cpp"; python3 -B private/evaluate.py "$tmp"; rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $rc

runner: Evaluator compiles C++ in a temporary directory. RSS is sampled by a fresh Python wrapper process using RUSAGE_CHILDREN for the single native child; core-supplied measurements are not trusted.
